ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of the vertical distribution of mountain vegetation, with the vertical axis representing altitude. The lower part of the mountain is labeled “mixed coniferous and broad-leaved forest”; the middle area above it is labeled “Jia”; further upward is “alpine meadow”; near the mountain summit there is “glacier.” Therefore, Jia is located above “mixed coniferous and broad-leaved forest” and below “alpine meadow,” and belongs to a mid-to-high-altitude forest belt. Reasoning: In the vertical natural belt spectrum of mountains, the relatively cold forest belt above mixed coniferous and broad-leaved forest and below meadow usually corresponds to coniferous forest. Therefore, the vegetation at location Jia should be coniferous forest.
